prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after seeing a truck for sale that looks just like your old one.
response:
"Hey kiddo, it’s Dad. Give me a call back when you get a second... well, actually, you don't even have to call back, it's nothing important. I just... you are not gonna believe what I just drove past. 

I’m over by the hardware store out on Route 7, and sitting right there on the grass with a 'For Sale' sign in the window is a truck that looks exactly like your old one. I mean, *exactly*. Same color, same extended cab, same rusted-out wheel wells. I actually pulled over and walked up to it just to check if it had that dent in the rear bumper from when you backed into our mailbox. It didn't—but man, I had to do a double-take! 

Anyway, I took a picture of it. I’m gonna try to text it to you right now if I can get this smartphone to cooperate. Just gave me a real blast from the past. Made me think of you, and all those weekends we spent in the driveway trying to keep that old thing running. 

Alright, well, hope work is going good. Your mom says hi. Call us this weekend if you've got some free time. Love ya. Bye."
